create_ObjHoldFixedEnvV0: create an ObjHoldFixedEnvV0 environment instance with a given MuJoCo model path for object holding tasks
create_ObjHoldRandomEnvV0: create an ObjHoldRandomEnvV0 environment that randomizes the goal position on each reset call
run_get_obs_vec: run get_obs_vec to extract hand qpos, qvel, object position, and error into an observation vector
run_get_reward_dict: run get_reward_dict to compute goal distance, bonus, penalty, sparse, dense reward and done flags
review_get_obs_dict: review get_obs_dict method that builds an observation dictionary from a MuJoCo simulation state
